checkEngineGpuUnused: {{backend}} is a CPU-only build, so {{gpus}} will sit idle. Pick a GPU backend in Settings to use it.
checkEngineVendorMismatch: {{backend}} needs an {{vendor}} GPU, but Flint found {{gpus}}. Flint will run on CPU.
checkEngineRuntimeUnreachable: {{backend}} cannot reach your GPU, so Flint will run on CPU. This usually means the GPU driver or runtime needs updating.
checkEngineMissingLibrary: {{backend}} cannot start because a required library is missing ({{libraries}}), so Flint will run on CPU.
checkEngineProbeFailed: Could not confirm the engine can use your GPU
checkEngineUnavailable: This engine build cannot report GPU status
checkSearchNoVector: The embedding model returned no result, so file search will not work yet
checkSearchInvalidVector: The embedding model returned an unusable result, so file search may return nothing
checkSearchProbeFailed: Could not verify the embedding model
checkSearchUnavailable: This engine build cannot verify the embedding model
welcomeTitle: Flint needs to set up on your system
welcomeBody: This takes a few minutes: Flint downloads its inference engine and a small model for file search. You can keep using your computer while it runs.
setupDoneBody: Flint will run local models with llama.cpp.
finishBody: Flint runs on this device. It contacts Hugging Face only when you open Discover, search, or click Download — otherwise you bring your own models.
finishNoModels: No local models yet. Import a GGUF file from Settings whenever you are ready; you can finish setup without one.
